comments.Text: Notion is unusable when I'm on a flight. Edits I make offline get blown away when I reconnect.
The mobile app stutters badly once a page has more than a few hundred lines.
Paying $10 a month for what's basically a glorified wiki is highway robbery.
I genuinely love the database views, no complaints there.
Tried to draft a doc on the subway and lost half of it when I got back to wifi. Never again.
Below-threshold comment that should not enter the quote pool under productivity defaults.
Zero-engagement reply, definitely should drop out.
